long_biography.plain_text:
Electrical cable engineering defined William Leonard Tregoning's long association with First Electronics Corporation. His 1978 patent described a moulded conductive junction for shielded cable assemblies, a technology suited to aerospace and other demanding uses. Later public business records identified him as president of the Boston manufacturer.

First Electronics specialised in high-reliability cable assemblies, wiring harnesses and electro-mechanical systems. As a family-owned supplier, it produced custom components for military applications, including communications, targeting and propulsion equipment on Bradley fighting vehicles. Production combined rapid prototyping with short runs of custom bulk cable, extensive mould tooling and inspection to military specifications. The operation served demanding programmes in which reliability and the ability to support urgent production were central requirements.
